title: NormalizedRecord
description: Execution Plan section 3.1. Produced by A1 ingest+normalize. This is the single source of truth for the shape; pydantic and TypeScript types are generated from this file, never hand-edited.

work_id.description: Unique identifier for the work. Fatal if missing (eng review Success Criteria table).

state.description: Fatal if missing: no peer group, no filtering.

implementing_district_authority.description: IDA_NAME from the Works Sanctioned tile: the Implementing District Authority that administers the work and owns the clause 4.5.2 annual inspection duty (MPLADS Guidelines 2023). The per-District-Authority quota and frozen district rank group by this field. Never used to fill implementing_agency (F-01, nemotronreview.md).

implementing_agency.description: IA_NAME from the Expenditure tile's payment events (the modal value per work, alphabetical tie-break): the Implementing Agency that executes the work. Null when the work has no payment event yet; never filled from implementing_district_authority (F-01). Degradable for the table, fatal for the fund-flow graph (M5).

vendor_id.description: Stable source vendor identifier from the MPLADS expenditure tile. Null when the source provides no identifier; graph construction must never fall back to vendor_name as identity.

vendor_name.description: Degradable for the table, fatal for the fund-flow graph (M5). Least likely field to be publicly exposed.

work_category.description: Fatal if missing: no category means no peer group, and peer group is mandatory on every flagged record.

work_description.description: The recommendation's own free text from the Sanctioned tile (WORK_DESCRIPTION), spacing tidied and nothing else. Degradable: only the duplicate finder, the detail panel and the header search read it.

activity_name.description: The portal's own activity string with its work-reference prefix stripped, one of 112 live values. Degradable: work_category stays the field every detector groups by.

recommendation_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or null. The date the MP recommended the work, from RECOMMENDATION_DATE. Degradable: nothing scores on it yet.

sanctioned_amount_inr.description: Fatal if missing: the cost-outlier detector is the primary flag.

expenditure_amount_inr.description: Degradable: loses the expenditure-mismatch flag, keeps the rest.

sanction_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or null. Degradable: needed for stalled-work detection.

source_rung.description: Which acquisition rung produced this record. See Execution Plan section 2.
